description: Read one stock's public on-chain activity: its price, 24-hour change, market cap and tokenized value, its holder count, each token's supply and premium by chain and tokenizer, and its recent large movements. An old price is marked stale and carries no 24-hour change. Give a chain or a tokenizer to narrow the tokens and the movements.

chain.description: A chain id or a plain chain name, such as solana, base or arbitrum.

stock.description: The stock's public slug, its ticker such as aapl or nvda.

tokenizer.description: A tokenizer's public slug, such as xstocks or ondo.

name: get_market_activity
title: Get market activity
